title: Other Discoveries, 1937-8 (Aqueducts, wells, reservoirs): Sh. Jarrah Quarter, Jerusalem
author: (round-up, Department of Antiquities)
location_note: About 3 m east of the main Nablus road, Sheikh Jarrah quarter, Jerusalem; no map reference; placed by name.
notes: Found by workmen building a house: rock-cut, slab-roofed channel seen for 22 m, 60-70 cm wide, parallel to the Nablus road; another section was found farther north in 1901 (cited). OCR gives the depth as '44 metres' (probably 4.4 m; not corrected).

features.site: Sheikh Jarrah quarter, east of the Nablus road
features.subtype: deep rock-cut channel roofed with rough slabs (excavator: 'some form of aqueduct' bringing water from the north)
features.quote: A deep rock-cut channel was discovered by workmen employed
